_comment: Sample DNFT metadata following the OpenSea ERC-1155 standard (https://docs.opensea.io/docs/metadata-standards). Replace all placeholder values before uploading.
name: DecentHead #1
description: A limited-edition DecentHead collectible from DecentMarket — the first of its kind on the decent canvas.
_image_note: Replace <image-cid> with the actual IPFS CID returned after uploading the image. CIDs look like 'bafybei…' (CIDv1/base32) or 'Qm…' (CIDv0/base58). Always use the ipfs:// scheme — never an HTTP gateway URL.
_animation_url_note: Set to an ipfs:// URI pointing to a video (.mp4/.webm) or interactive HTML file when available. Leave empty string when unused.
_properties_note: Reserved for future 3D and layout features, and for Product DNFT-specific metadata. Extend these sub-fields rather than adding new top-level keys so existing metadata consumers are not broken.

properties._layout_note: 2-D canvas placement config, e.g. { x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1, rotation: 0 }
properties._model3d_note: ipfs:// URI of a glTF/GLB 3D model file, e.g. 'ipfs://bafybei…/model.glb'
properties._product_note: Product DNFT schema v1 fields (Issue #5). Present only when kind === 'Product'. Extend here for future product types.

product._repo_url_note: Canonical source repository for this product artifact.
product._commit_note: Exact commit hash or GitHub permalink for the version this token represents.
product._artifact_cid_note: IPFS CID of the zipped source/artifact snapshot.
product._opensea_url_note: OpenSea listing URL. Fill in after first mint.
